body:
### Summary

In our Azure Devops CI, when we create our environment we see this message:
```
...
Prepared 45 packages in 1.47s
warning: Failed to hardlink files; falling back to full copy. This may lead to degraded performance.
         If the cache and target directories are on different filesystems, hardlinking may not be supported.
         If this is intentional, set `export UV_LINK_MODE=copy` or use `--link-mode=copy` to suppress this warning.
Installed 45 packages in 796ms
 + argcomplete==3.7.2
...
```
I was concerned that the performance of Python might be worsened here, but after sparring with AI, it seems that this only refers to environment creation (and maybe specifically caching?).

It would be great if the text "This may lead to degraded performance." could be change to "This may lead to degraded performance during environment creation."

title: Improve warning message when uv "Failed to hardlink files"
